title: スプリングSの後に・クラシック三冠へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her daily unrelenting training, Mihono Bourbon manages to complete the Spring Stakes with flying colors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next race will be the first step toward finally achieving her dream. Ahead of her, the Satsuki Sho awaits.
